correctness.rationale: For odd b>=7, inversion reciprocity and the published Proposition 2.6 give three disjoint multiplier regimes. In the small regime the difference factors as (a-3)(b+1)(b+1-3a)/(12a); in the large regime concave N_b(c) is positive at 1 and b/3; in the middle regime concave P_b(a) is positive at b/3 and 2b/3. Equality only at a=3 and inverse 3 when b=2 mod 3, and the known two smaller inversion values are excluded. Exact computational spot checks corroborate all boundaries; unrestricted proof does not rest on enumeration.
